more_info.overview: Brown FK is a mixture of several sodium salts of azo dyes and related colouring substances, rather than one pure colour molecule. Its colouring function is to add or restore colour in the food. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
